text:
```yaml
name: Kani Verification

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  kani-verification:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Rust
      uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
      with:
        toolchain: stable
        profile: minimal
        override: true

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: cargo build --all --features kani

    - name: Run Kani verification
      run: cargo kani --crate storage
```
